per_line.literal: **ENGINE-UNPROVEN-GRIND-RANGE-04 — Locked:** Starting, unproven **Grind** guidance displays a narrow interval around the existing personal recommendation center rather than implying one exact grinder setting. For personal reference use one calibrated grind-adjustment step on each side; for uncalibrated heuristic use two steps on each side, bounded by the configured grinder range.
